description: External sidecar signing key. The Ed25519 private key resides outside the agent process. Only the public key is published. Process compromise does not enable receipt forgery.
behavior_evidence_model: Each action has two signed artifacts: the 30-field CCS L1 receipt (authorization/chain integrity) and a linked ccs.behavior_evidence.v1 receipt (semantic observation). Both are signed and linked by linked_l1_receipt_digest.
